text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road feels a deep sense of 
dread over TM Opera O's "toughness" and 
Admire Vega's "sharpness"...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road worried that she lacked 
the weapons her two rivals possessed. Her 
Trainer stepped forward and handed her a 
sheet of paper outlining her greatest 
strength: her well-rounded, comprehensive 
ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that, she finally understood... 
She wanted to repay the Trainer who had 
been so good to her. And in that feeling, 
she wouldn't lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, weaponizing her desire to 
meet her fans' expectations, she aims to 
prove her strength in the second leg of 
the Classic Triple Crown: the Japanese 
Derby!
